```{python}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display
from plotnine import *

DATA = Path("exports")
FIGURES = Path("../../imgs/daphnia")
MODELS = ["IFAD-0.97", "IFAD-1", "IFAD-0", "MPIF"]
ORDER = ["IFAD-0", "IFAD-0.97", "IFAD-1", "MPIF"]

final = pd.read_csv(DATA / "final_estimates.csv")
traces = pd.read_csv(DATA / "loglik_traces.csv.gz")
timings = pd.read_csv(DATA / "timings.csv")

assert final.groupby("model")["rep"].nunique().eq(50).all()
assert traces.groupby(["model", "checkpoint"])["rep"].nunique().eq(50).all()
FIGURES.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
```

# Settings

The 38-parameter Daphnia model is fitted from 50 matched starting points.
IFAD uses 200 MPIF iterations followed by 200 Adam updates; MPIF alone uses
680 iterations. All searches use 1,000 particles per mesocosm and one Tesla
V100 GPU, with two starts per batch.

The MPIF perturbation SD is 0.05 on the log scale, with a geometric cooling
factor of 0.7 per 50 iterations. Adam uses a peak learning rate of 0.01,
10 warmup updates, and a cosine schedule with final multiplier 0.1.
Likelihood evaluations use 2,000 particles per mesocosm and 10 independent
particle filters. The best final parameter vector from each method is
independently re-evaluated with the same particle count and number of replicates.

# Final log-likelihoods

The summary and plots include all 50 starts per method. MCSE is shown in
parentheses.

```{python}
#| label: final-summary
#| echo: false
summary = []
for model in MODELS:
    frame = final.loc[final["model"] == model]
    best = frame.loc[frame["logLik"].idxmax()]
    assert best[["reevaluated_logLik", "reevaluated_MCSE"]].notna().all()
    summary.append({
        "Method": model,
        "Best log-likelihood (MCSE)": f"{best['logLik']:.2f} ({best['MCSE']:.2f})",
        "Median": f"{frame['logLik'].median():.2f}",
        "Re-evaluated (MCSE)": (
            f"{best['reevaluated_logLik']:.2f} ({best['reevaluated_MCSE']:.2f})"
        ),
    })
display(pd.DataFrame(summary).set_index("Method"))
```

```{python}
#| label: final-loglik
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.8
#| echo: false
df_raincloud = pd.concat([
    final.loc[final["model"] == model, ["rep", "logLik", "MCSE"]].assign(Model=model)
    for model in ORDER
], ignore_index=True)
df_raincloud["Model"] = pd.Categorical(
    df_raincloud["Model"], categories=ORDER, ordered=True
)
model_map = {label: float(index) for index, label in enumerate(ORDER)}
df_raincloud["Model_num"] = df_raincloud["Model"].map(model_map).astype(float)
df_raincloud["Model_violin_x"] = df_raincloud["Model_num"] + 0.05
df_raincloud["Model_boxplot_x"] = df_raincloud["Model_num"] - 0.1
np.random.seed(42)
df_raincloud["Model_jitter_x"] = (
    df_raincloud["Model_num"] - 0.30
    + np.random.uniform(-0.04, 0.04, size=len(df_raincloud))
)
tick_step = 2 if np.ptp(df_raincloud["logLik"].to_numpy()) <= 20 else 5
min_loglik_tick = int(np.floor(df_raincloud["logLik"].min() / tick_step) * tick_step)
max_loglik_tick = int(np.ceil(df_raincloud["logLik"].max() / tick_step) * tick_step)
tick_breaks = list(range(min_loglik_tick, max_loglik_tick + tick_step, tick_step))

p_violin = (
    ggplot(df_raincloud, aes(y="logLik", fill="Model", color="Model"))
    + geom_violin(
        aes(x="Model_violin_x", group="Model"), style="right",
        width=1.0, alpha=0.6, show_legend=False,
    )
    + geom_boxplot(
        aes(x="Model_boxplot_x", group="Model"), width=0.10,
        alpha=0.6, color="black", outlier_alpha=0, size=0.8, show_legend=False,
    )
    + geom_point(aes(x="Model_jitter_x"), alpha=0.6, size=1.5, show_legend=False)
    + coord_flip()
    + scale_x_continuous(breaks=[0, 1, 2, 3], labels=ORDER)
    + scale_y_continuous(breaks=tick_breaks)
    + labs(title="", subtitle="", x="", y="Log-Likelihood")
    + theme_minimal()
    + theme(
        axis_text_x=element_text(size=14, color="black"),
        axis_text_y=element_text(size=14, color="black"),
        axis_title_x=element_text(size=15, color="black"),
        axis_title_y=element_text(size=15, color="black"),
        panel_grid_major_y=element_blank(), panel_grid_minor_y=element_blank(),
        panel_grid_major_x=element_line(color="#e5e5e5", size=0.8),
        panel_grid_minor_x=element_blank(),
        figure_size=(7, 3.8), dpi=300,
    )
)
p_violin.save(FIGURES / "daphnia_violin.pdf", width=7, height=3.8, verbose=False)
display(p_violin)
```

# Times

Times are summed over the 25 batches and include compilation. Optimization
time excludes particle-filter evaluation. Checkpoint PF time covers the
additional initial and intermediate evaluations.

```{python}
#| label: times
#| echo: false
runtime, transition = [], []
for model in MODELS:
    frame = timings.loc[timings["model"] == model]
    stages = frame.groupby("method")["seconds"].sum()
    optimization = stages.reindex(["mif", "train"], fill_value=0).sum()
    runtime.append({
        "Method": model,
        "MPIF (s)": f"{stages['mif']:.1f}",
        "DMOP (s)": f"{stages.get('train', 0.0):.1f}",
        "Optimization (s)": f"{optimization:.1f}",
        "Checkpoint PF (s)": f"{stages['pfilter']:.1f}",
    })
    if model != "MPIF":
        transition.append({"source": model, "time_scaled": stages["mif"]})
display(pd.DataFrame(runtime).set_index("Method"))
df_transition = pd.DataFrame(transition)
df_transition["source"] = pd.Categorical(
    df_transition["source"], categories=ORDER, ordered=True
)
```

# Search progress

Lines show medians across 50 starts; ribbons span the 10th percentile to the
maximum. Dotted vertical lines mark the switch from MPIF to Adam. Checkpoint
times are mapped linearly within each phase using the summed batch runtimes.
The plot shows log-likelihoods above −890.

```{python}
#| label: search-progress
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.8
#| echo: false
df_stats = (
    traces.groupby(["model", "checkpoint", "stage", "iteration", "time_scaled"])["logLik"]
    .agg(median="median", q10=lambda x: np.percentile(x, 10), qmax="max")
    .reset_index().rename(columns={"model": "source"})
)
df_stats["source"] = pd.Categorical(df_stats["source"], categories=ORDER, ordered=True)
df_stats = df_stats.sort_values(["source", "time_scaled"])

p2 = (
    ggplot(df_stats, aes(x="time_scaled", y="median", color="source"))
    + geom_line(size=1.2)
    + geom_line(
        aes(y="q10", color="source"), data=df_stats[df_stats["source"] != "MPIF"],
        alpha=0.2, size=0.6, show_legend=False,
    )
    + geom_line(
        aes(y="qmax", color="source"), data=df_stats[df_stats["source"] != "MPIF"],
        alpha=0.2, size=0.6, show_legend=False,
    )
    + geom_line(
        aes(y="q10", color="source"), data=df_stats[df_stats["source"] == "MPIF"],
        alpha=0.35, size=0.6, show_legend=False,
    )
    + geom_line(
        aes(y="qmax", color="source"), data=df_stats[df_stats["source"] == "MPIF"],
        alpha=0.35, size=0.6, show_legend=False,
    )
    + geom_ribbon(
        aes(ymin="q10", ymax="qmax", fill="source"),
        data=df_stats[df_stats["source"] != "MPIF"], alpha=0.1, color=None,
    )
    + geom_ribbon(
        aes(ymin="q10", ymax="qmax", fill="source"),
        data=df_stats[df_stats["source"] == "MPIF"], alpha=0.1, color=None,
    )
    + labs(title="", subtitle="", x="Optimization Time (Seconds)", y="Log-Likelihood")
    + theme_minimal()
    + theme(
        axis_text_x=element_text(size=14, color="black"),
        axis_text_y=element_text(size=14, color="black"),
        axis_title_x=element_text(size=15, color="black"),
        axis_title_y=element_text(size=15, color="black"),
        legend_text=element_text(size=12, color="black"),
        legend_title=element_blank(), legend_position="right",
        panel_grid_major=element_line(color="#e5e5e5", size=0.8),
        panel_grid_minor=element_blank(),
        figure_size=(7, 3.8), dpi=300,
    )
    + geom_vline(
        aes(xintercept="time_scaled", color="source"), data=df_transition,
        linetype="dotted", size=1.0, show_legend=False,
    )
    + coord_cartesian(ylim=(-890, None))
)
p2.save(FIGURES / "daphnia_figure5.pdf", width=7, height=3.8, verbose=False)
display(p2)
```
